question: Should Cetraria islandica be recommended for: demulcent for irritation of the mouth and throat mucosa with associated dry cough, and temporary loss of appetite?

records.notes: EU herbal monograph on Iceland moss (Cetraria islandica) thallus grants traditional-use registration only, based on at least 30 years of use including 15 in the EU; the HMPC states plausibility rests on long-standing use, not demonstrated clinical efficacy.
